item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a Lula-led overhaul of prison complaint systems, civilian oversight bodies beyond police body-cam/use-of-force reforms, or a broader independent-investigation architecture for abuse by intelligence services, prison staff, militias, or informal loyalists.
